# Noosa App

> The Noosa App ("Noosa App: Local Guide" on the App Store) is a free iPhone guide to Noosa, Queensland, Australia, made by locals. It reads the tide, the weather and the time of day, then shows what's good right now.

- Free to download. No account or sign-up. iPhone only for now (no Android).
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/noosa-app-local-guide/id6828637417
- Made by co-founders Sam Wilson-Smith and Jasmin Haidenthaler, who live in Noosa. Noosa App is a business name of J Haidenthaler & S.J Wilson-Smith (ABN 42 957 931 637).
- Contact: noosaapp@gmail.com

## What it does

- Today: live tide, sunset, water temperature and surf for Noosa, with ideas that suit the conditions right now.
- What's on: live music, markets and trivia this week, and Noosa's big festivals through the year, checked with the venues every week.
- Explore and Map: about 150 beaches, national park walks, cafes, restaurants, bars, tours and day trips, picked by locals, with what suits this time of day first.
- Borrow a local's day: ready-made days timed to the tide and the sunset, added to your plan in one tap.
- Plan: a plan for each day of your trip, with a small map and an optional reminder before each stop. Your plan stays on your phone.
- Works without signal: it keeps a saved copy of the weather and the places.

## Where it covers

Noosa Heads, Noosaville, Tewantin, Sunshine Beach and Peregian, plus the Noosa hinterland, the Noosa Everglades, the Noosa North Shore and Coolum.
